newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trade bodies to hold import car shows.
newsitem.headline: Japan trade bodies to hold import car shows.

text.p: The Japan Automobile Importers Association said on Thursday it will hold an imported car show in Tokyo for three days in mid-January with the Japan External Trade Organisation (JETRO) as co-organiser.
The show starting on January 17 at the Tokyo Big Site exhibition complex in Tokyo will feature about 230 foreign cars imported from nine countries.
The two groups have been holding import car shows in major cities since 1994.
A similar show was held in Osaka last weekend and shows are planned for Nagoya on January 10-12, Sapporo on February 1-2 and Fukuoka on February 7-9.
The organisers expect 230,000 people to visit the Tokyo show.

Japanese sales of imported passenger cars rose 11 percent from a year earlier to 325,801 in the January to October period, accounting for 10.7 percent of total sales during that time, industry data showed.
